method.market: Archived OANDA XAUUSD M15; existing Scalp 1:1 qualified setups only.
method.eligibility: T1/T2/T3; H4 structure + EMA20/50; H1 continuation/Far; 30-pip pattern SL buffer; minimum 250-unit volume decrease. Existing archived entry eligibility is retained.
method.primaryMetric: BUY: max(0, next open - next low) / abs(confirmation close - confirmation open) * 100. SELL mirrors with next high - next open.
method.alternateMetric: BUY: max(0, confirmation close - next low) / confirmation body * 100; SELL mirrors. This corresponds to the earlier suggested close-minus-body-fraction limit price.
method.interpretation: Cumulative percentages are price-touch frequencies within the entire immediate next M15 candle, not win rates, broker fill probabilities, or identification of the future low. 100% means one confirming candle body, not a 100% move in gold price.
method.wick: The primary metric includes next candles that continue against the signal. Actual wick and close-in-signal-direction counts are recorded separately. A dip is not necessarily rejection.
method.scope: Includes all eligible archived outcomes, not only winners or filled trades. Does not rescan signals rejected under original entry rules. Exact consecutive completed next bars required.
method.timing: No inference about whether dip occurred before a rally, TP or SL. M15 OHLC cannot resolve order. Touch can occur after the original setup was invalidated. No hypothetical PnL estimated.
method.limitations: Retrospective descriptive sample of about 3.5 months. No spread, bid/ask, commission, slippage, live trading gates or portfolio constraints; repeated signals can be dependent. Thresholds are not optimized or forward validated.
method.pips: Existing dashboard gold convention: 1 pip = 0.1 price units.
